notes: Variant WLC.DEU.7.9.v001 resolved to r00-base, covering s026–s027; no fallback exclusion arises, so rule 53 is not engaged.

שֹׁמֵר is articleless, so its supplied *who* stays with the participle under rule 41's closing paragraph, while the arthrous הַנֶּאֱמָן is rendered prenominally and its agreement article is unrepresented under rule 47.
The second לְ (s024) is unrepresented because the ASV writes one *with* for the coordinated pair (rule 22), and the second participle takes only the *keep* written for it (rule 46's second rider).
